mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the two circulation routes was most worthwhile: the continuous arrows made it clear that one full lap goes through the heart twice.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to connect the lung route to the left heart was frustrating because their labels appeared to match, but the result did not explain the missing prerequisite.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the labelled lung return could not connect to the left heart until the body route was built too.

arbitrary.text: That same prerequisite felt arbitrary: the labels suggested a connection, but did not indicate why it had to wait.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter: seeing the two routes join and then adding the heart's own supply made the larger system easier to picture.
